profile.name: 西门子 S7 可编程逻辑控制器
profile.description: 这是一类工业可编程逻辑控制器（PLC），常用于实验室自动化、测试台控制、设备联锁、数据采集与顺序控制。该设备通常通过以太网使用 ISO on TCP / S7 通信协议与上位机交换控制命令和过程数据。
profile.description_en: This is an industrial programmable logic controller (PLC) commonly used for laboratory automation, test stand control, equipment interlocks, data acquisition, and sequence control. It typically communicates with host systems over Ethernet using the ISO on TCP / S7 protocol to exchange control commands and process data.
